name: t_one_blocker
note: The solver's best-response game. Seat 0 has Goblin Assailant (2/2, asked first) and Centaur Courser (3/3); seat 1, at 3 life, has one untapped Walking Corpse (2/2) and nothing else. With both attacking a perfect opponent blocks the Courser and takes 2; either alone is blocked. Every option is 0. An opponent that never blocks loses to either attack, and one that blocks the first attacker it is offered loses to both.
